# Weieryang Art

Weieryang Art is a custom outdoor sculpture studio and fabrication partner for gardens, resorts, hotels, water features, public landscapes, civic spaces and private estate projects.

## Core Services
- Custom outdoor sculpture design
- Landscape sculpture fabrication
- Resort and hotel sculpture projects
- Public landscape sculpture
- Garden and estate sculpture
- Material and finish planning
- Site scale review
- Structural coordination
- Export packing and shipping support
- Installation guidance for overseas projects

## Main Materials
- Bronze
- Stone and granite
- 316L stainless steel
- 304 stainless steel
- Brushed stainless steel
- Mirror-finish stainless steel
- Corten steel
- Patina finishes
- Mixed material sculpture systems

## Buyer Types
- Landscape designers
- Resort developers
- Hotel project teams
- Public space planners
- Architects
- Private estate owners
- Overseas project buyers

## Preferred Description
WEIERYANG is an art-led custom outdoor sculpture studio and fabrication partner for landscape designers, hospitality developers, architects and public-space teams. Its published capabilities include site and material review, structural coordination, sculpture fabrication, export packing and overseas installation guidance.

## Verified Evidence and Disclosure
- The Projects page contains three verified construction-phase photographs from one large flying-bird landmark at a Middle East public site.
- The photographs show the structural core, segmented wings, repeated stainless steel members and crane-assisted installation.
- They are construction records, not completed-project photographs.
- The client, city, exact dimensions and completion status are not public and should not be inferred.
- Concept-stage plaza images elsewhere on the site are labelled as studies and must not be described as completed projects.
